curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Accustomed to winning over anyone in his path, what happens when the legendary seducer's signature charm meets complete indifference?
curatedMovie.description: In Lasse Hallström's romantic adventure, an infamous womanizer accustomed to effortless seduction meets his match in a woman completely immune to his charms, sparking an unexpected pursuit that turns into genuine love.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A lively, mid-tempo romantic romp balancing playful comedy with moderate emotional warmth, tailor-made for an engaging date night.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Lasse Hallström blends period adventure and romantic comedy, turning a legendary rake's pursuit into a funny, emotionally grounded date-night duel of wits.
